Ram Temple Trust Faces Scrutiny Amidst Theft Allegations and Resignations

Allegations of theft and financial irregularities have surfaced concerning the Ram Temple trust in Ayodhya, leading to significant internal developments. The trust's president has called for strict punishment for any accused, while also urging that the matter not be politicized. Meanwhile, reports indicate that key officials, including the general secretary, have resigned, with the trust's board deliberating on these decisions.
